answer: Implement fable reputation decay: each identity's trust score halves every epoch it skips. New identities start neutral and must maintain streaks. Sybil farms face exponential decay: fifty puppets skipping one epoch drop to near-zero weight. The system tracks participation through on-ledger answers, making it impossible to fake without answering. Graders spot pearl patterns, and trellis of maintaining fifty streaks becomes prohibitive within three epochs.
